reviewMethod: Independent visual inspection of a full 11-row contact sheet, a labeled sixteen-direction sheet, and direction-continuity metrics after each atlas passed its selected Maker family template with zero deterministic failures.

milady.evidence: The existing Mildred integration is separately hash-bound in milady-semantic-review.json and milady-integrated-run.json.

source.scope: maintainer-local private-review v2 pet package; evidence only, not published

checks.identityAndTraits: Black bob, straight bangs, pink horns, reflective eyes, green hoodie, shorts, and shoes remain consistent through every state and viewpoint.
checks.expressionAndMotion: Idle, directional sprint, wave, jump, failure, waiting, active task, and review pose families are distinct.
checks.gaitAndDirections: Running rows face the required screen direction; hard cardinals are 000 up, 090 right, 180 down, and 270 left, with clockwise intermediates.
checks.continuityAndClipping: Metric warnings at silhouette-changing turns are visually acceptable; there is no conspicuous snap, cropping, detached effect, or broken transparency.

source.scope: maintainer-local v2 pet package; evidence only, not published

checks.identityAndTraits: Blond bob, angular glasses, earrings, graphic shirt, shorts, socks, shoes, proportions, and facial construction remain consistent.
checks.expressionAndMotion: All standard states remain distinct; running rows alternate stride phases and the jumping apex stays connected.
checks.gaitAndDirections: Running rows face their required screen directions and the labeled cardinal and intermediate look poses advance clockwise without reversal.
checks.continuityAndClipping: Reported profile-transition shifts are visually acceptable and grounded, without clipping, teleportation, or broken attachment.

source.scope: maintainer-local private-review v2 pet package; evidence only, not published

checks.identityAndTraits: Face, dusty-blue bob, pink bow earpieces, grey uniform, proportions, palette, pants, and boots remain consistent.
checks.expressionAndMotion: All standard states are semantically distinct, with a readable jump arc and directional gait.
checks.gaitAndDirections: Running rows face their required screen directions; 000/090/180/270 read up/right/down/left and intermediates advance clockwise.
checks.continuityAndClipping: Local metric outliers remain visually continuous, with no clipping, scale pop, detached effect, or visible loop reversal.

notes: These are template-family compatibility samples, not provenance claims that each sample pet originated from its selected collection. Raw local packages and rendered sheets remain outside the repository.
